description: A for directive over the null keyword is an error
notes: The spec lists tuple, object, list, map and set types as iterable but doesn't say what iterating a null value does; treating it as empty would also be reasonable. The null keyword is a null of the dynamic pseudo-type, so only being null makes it fail. hashicorp/hcl reports an error for any null collection: ForExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go, the node a for directive is parsed into, checks IsNull before anything else.
